Here is a version of Messier 13. A globular cluster located 25,100 light-years away in the constellation Hercules .

Equipment
Takahashi FS78 refractor
Canon 40D unfiltered @ ISO 200
Hutech IDAS LPS filter
Lx200 10" Classic mount
Guided by PHD via the lx200 10"
10 frames of 300 sec, 20 dark, 20 flat, 20 bias
Pre-processing in Nebolusity
Processing in Photoshop

Image at about 15%



Image at about 50%
